'''Flan pâtissier nature''' is a traditional preparation often found in French bakeries and patisseries. This recipe is a base to which you can add fruit or other ingredients.

== Ingredients ==
* 500 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] whole [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
* 150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]] or 10 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Fructose|fructose]]
* 80 g (8 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]]) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
* 3 whole [[Cookbook:Eggs|eggs]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
* 200 g [[Cookbook:Puff Pastry|puff pastry]], rolled to 3–6 [[Cookbook:Mm|mm]] thick

== Procedure==

# Preheat [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 200°C. If using frozen puff pastry take it out from the freezer.
# Heat the milk in a [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]] until [[Cookbook:Scalding|scalding]] but not boiling.
# In a bowl, mix the sugar and the cornstarch, then beat in the whole eggs. Very gradually [[Cookbook:Whisk|whisk]] the hot milk into this mixture to avoid cooking the egg. Add the vanilla extract, and return this mixture to the saucepan.
# Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat, stirring constantly to avoid curdling. Remove from the heat before it gets to the boiling point.
# Line a buttered metal [[Cookbook:Pie and Tart Pans|pie pan]] with the puff pastry to make a crust. Fill the crust with the hot custard.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 25–30 minutes in the preheated oven until golden on the top. Cool to room temperature, then chill in the refrigerator.
